scope: Complete PeakFileOptions value/state API plus required NumpressCompression/NumpressConfig values; excludes every Numpress codec operation and all format execution/wiring.

mass_time_warning.literal: Warning, compression of m/z or time dimension with pic or slof algorithms can lead to data loss

independent_derivations: DIntervalBase default is DPosition maxPositive/minNegative, i.e. finite f64::MAX/f64::MIN. DRange header incorrectly describes zero defaults.
DIntervalBase::isEmpty compares the exact sentinel, so equal endpoints do not disable RT.
Other range setters force their independent enabled state; hasFilters is RT OR MS levels OR precursor-m/z only.
MS-level copy/membership preserves signed values, duplicates, and caller order.
Numpress setters store every scalar verbatim and getters copy config values; only mass/time PIC and SLOF issue a warning.
native_boundaries: Scientific option fields do not implement or silently enable any reader/writer behavior.
NumericRange is reused as endpoint storage, not its usual inclusive-bound interpretation; DRange point-constructor normalization is not performed by the option setter.
MS-level storage has a fixed 1,000,000-element preallocation bound with atomic setter failure.
Mass/time warning is returned as optional exact text for caller-controlled logging instead of unconditional stderr.
No C++ sentinel enum variant is exposed as a valid compression mode.
method: Source-only extraction and independently specified state tests. No C++ build/execution and no production outputs used to manufacture expected values.
license: OpenMS source BSD-3-Clause; no new redistributed algorithm dependency or data resource.
